rationale: The assistant tied the loose door to the catch, gave a hold-the-door test, and once the customer reported the snapped tongue it confirmed the diagnosis and recommended a replacement door catch. It asked for the model number before ordering and told the customer to compare the old piece with photos, so it made no compatibility claim. It warned against bypassing the switch and taping the door shut. Minor weaknesses are a long generic first reply, a repeated recall note, and slightly overconfident wording ('the whole problem'), though the evidence supports it.
